analysis.reasonEn: Recent strong upward momentum with three consecutive days of gains (+7.38%, +2.56%, +5.26%) has pushed RSI to 66.5, nearing overbought territory. MACD histogram continues to improve from 5.0710 to 5.5817, supporting the bullish trend. The 5-day low ($278.94) is higher than the 20-day low ($259.11), forming a Higher Low pattern and strengthening the recovery signal. Considering a buy entry based on the swing support at $300.50.

· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation) — Considering buy entry based on swing support ($300.50) before RSI enters overbought.
